title: Step 60-C shared listing foundation
description: Implement only the shared Storefront listing foundation required by later Step 60 Search and Category stages: generated-OpenAPI-derived listing/product-card types, deterministic URL query-state parsing/serialization for the currently supported q/cursor/limit contract, opaque cursor preservation/reset rules, shared ProductCard/List presentation primitives, logical RTL/responsive styling, and deterministic Stage-C verification. Do not productionize /search or /category/:slug yet; do not implement advanced filters/sort/pagination controls, backend/API/OpenAPI/database changes, business rules, Product Detail, Compare/Wishlist, Cart/Checkout, Admin, or new dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Shared listing/product-card types are aliases of generated OpenAPI components and successful responses; no parallel authoritative ProductCard, price, availability, pagination or search DTO is created.

URL state accepts only the currently supported shared q/cursor/limit dimensions: q is bounded to 200 characters when present, cursor remains opaque and bounded to 1024 characters, limit is an explicit integer 1..100, duplicate or undeclared keys fail closed, and no advanced filter/sort semantics are invented before Stage 60-F.

Serialization is deterministic and cursor state is preserved only while the query dimensions that define the result set remain unchanged; changing q or limit resets cursor rather than reusing stale continuation state.

Shared ProductCard presentation renders only authoritative generated fields for name, image, Toman price and availability; null price/image are represented honestly, no stock/discount/price value is fabricated, and the only commercial handoff is the existing Product Detail route reserved for Step 61.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront listing-foundation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/storefront static-quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage 60-C does not productionize Search or Category routes and does not fetch listing endpoints; /search and /category/:slug remain Step-60 placeholders until 60-D/60-E. No backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency/lockfile/current-state mutation occurs.

Canonical completion requires full root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, applicable Storefront quality checks, deterministic review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 60-D begins.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 60-C is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 60-D remains blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
